words.zh: n. 灾难，天灾
words.example: The earthquake in 2008 was a terrible disaster for many families.

words.zh: n. 龙卷风
words.example: A tornado destroyed several houses in the small town last night.

words.zh: n. 干旱，旱灾
words.example: The long drought caused many crops to die in the fields.

words.zh: n. 滑坡；崩塌；塌方
words.example: Heavy rain triggered a landslide that blocked the mountain road.

words.zh: v. 滑动，滑行；使滑动；滑倒；下跌；使滑入；滑落；【数】平移；  n. 滑面；滑行；下落；幻灯片；滑梯；滑道
words.example: The children love to slide down the big playground slide.

words.zh: n. 海啸
words.example: The tsunami warning caused everyone to move to higher ground immediately.

words.zh: n. 洪水；大量；  v. 淹没；大量涌入；充满；（使）灌满水；灌溉；泛滥；挤满
words.example: After the heavy rain, a flood covered most of the low-lying area.

words.zh: phr. 火山爆发
words.example: The volcanic eruption covered the nearby village with a thick layer of ash.

words.zh: n. 巨大；震级；重要性；【数】量值；规模，大小；【化】量级；【物】大小
words.example: The magnitude of the earthquake surprised everyone in the small town.

words.zh: v. 挽救；拯救，救援；  vt. 营救；救援；  n. 营救；救援
words.example: Firefighters managed to rescue the cat from the burning building.

words.zh: v. 损害，毁坏，破坏；破坏；  n. 损坏，毁坏，破坏；损失；损害；【化】损伤，损害
words.example: The heavy rain damaged many crops in the southern villages.

words.zh: v. 摧毁；毁灭；破坏
words.example: The tornado destroyed dozens of houses in just ten minutes.

words.zh: v. 疏散；撤离
words.example: The police ordered everyone to evacuate the area before the flood.

words.zh: n. 直升机；  v. 用直升飞机载送，乘直升机
words.example: A rescue helicopter arrived quickly and saved the injured hikers.

words.zh: n. 死亡；死神；毁灭；死
words.example: The accident caused the death of three passengers on the bus.

words.zh: v. 影响；深深打动；（疾病）侵袭；【化】影响；  n. 情感，心情；【精神病学】情绪反应
words.example: Too much screen time can seriously affect your eyesight.

words.zh: n. 隐蔽处，躲避处；庇护；居所，住处；避难所；遮蔽物；庇护处；  v. 遮蔽，庇护；保护；隐匿
words.example: The villagers used the cave as a shelter during the storm.

words.zh: v. （使）破裂，打碎；垮掉；断裂，折断；找到解决方法；  n. 裂缝；破裂声；挖苦话；强效纯可卡因；  adj. 优秀的，一流的；  adv. 尖锐地
words.example: The heat caused the old pipes to crack and leak water.

words.zh: v. 使吸入毒气；毒（死）；空谈；加汽油；  n. 煤气；天然气；气体；汽油；【化】气体；【物】气体；【航】气体；  adj. 〈美俚〉喝醉酒的
words.example: The soldiers were gassed with poison gas during the terrible war.

words.zh: phr. 好像，仿佛
words.example: He spoke slowly as if he were trying to remember something.

words.zh: v. 毁灭，毁坏；（使）破产；（使）堕落；  n. 废墟；毁灭
words.example: The heavy rain ruined our plans for a picnic in the park.

words.zh: phr. 严重受损，破败不堪
words.example: After the war, the whole city lay in ruins and looked terrible.

words.zh: n. 百分比，比例，部分；百分之……；  adj. 每一百中的；  adv. 每一百中地
words.example: About seventy percent of the students passed the math exam.

words.zh: n. 砖；积木；  vt. 用砖砌
words.example: The workers used a red brick to build the garden wall.

words.zh: v. （以金属）覆盖，装配；  n. 金属，合金，金属制品；【物】金属；  adj. 金属制的
words.example: The workers metaled the roof with thin sheets of steel.

words.zh: v. 使……震惊；使……震动；震惊；使难以置信；使触电，使遭电击；使不悦或生气；  n. 震惊；震动；休克；令人震惊的事；电击，触电；【医】休克
words.example: The sudden news of his death shocked everyone in the class.

words.zh: v. 使……震惊；使……震动；震惊；使难以置信；使触电，使遭电击；使不悦或生气；  n. 震惊；震动；休克；令人震惊的事；电击，触电；【医】休克
words.example: The mother stood in shock after hearing her son's accident.

words.zh: n. 电，电力；电流；电学；电能
words.example: The strong wind cut off electricity to the whole coastal city.

words.zh: n. 陷阱；捕兽夹，捕鼠器；险境；双轮轻便马车；嘴；  v. 困住；诱骗；收集；吸收；设陷阱捕捉，用捕捉器捕捉（动物）；使陷于危险中
words.example: The mouse fell into a trap set by the farmer.

words.zh: v. 埋葬；隐藏，埋藏；埋头于；抛开；遮盖
words.example: They will bury the time capsule in the school garden.

words.zh: v. 呼吸；低语；呼出
words.example: After running upstairs, she stopped to breathe deeply.

words.zh: v. （使）苏醒；（使）复苏，（使）复兴；再兴起；重做；（使）重新流行；（使）复活
words.example: Doctors tried hard to revive the drowned boy with CPR.

words.zh: n. 复苏，复兴
words.example: The revival of the local music festival attracted many tourists.

words.zh: n. 努力；艰难的尝试；尽力；力气，精力；努力的成果；试图
words.example: With great effort, the team managed to finish the task on time.

words.zh: v. 使联合，统一；使相同，使一致
words.example: The new leader hopes to unify the different groups in the country.

words.zh: n. 智慧，学问；明智，正确判断；名言，格言，古训；普遍的看法
words.example: Grandmother's wisdom helped us solve many problems in life.

words.zh: n. 上下文，语境；背景；【计】上下文
words.example: You can guess the meaning of a word from the context of the sentence.

words.zh: v. 感到（疼痛）；遭受（痛苦）；受折磨
words.example: Many people suffer from headaches when the weather changes suddenly.

words.zh: n. 火山
words.example: The volcano erupted and sent ash high into the sky.

words.zh: v. 爆发；（火山、喷泉、蒸汽等）喷发；使迸发；喷射出；（斑疹等）突然出现；突然发生
words.example: The volcano may erupt again within the next few days.

words.zh: v. 供给；提供；供应；【化】供应，提供；  n. 供应，供应量；补给；（复数）储备；供给品；贮备；【财】供给
words.example: The store will supply fresh water to the flood victims.

words.zh: n. 台风，强热带风暴
words.example: The typhoon destroyed many banana trees along the coast.

words.zh: phr. 户外；露天
words.example: We enjoyed a delicious dinner in the open air last night.

words.zh: n. 飓风；像飓风般猛烈的人（或物）
words.example: The hurricane destroyed many houses along the coast.

words.zh: vi. 生存，活着；  vt. 幸存；存活；艰难度过；比…活得长；  v. 【法】继续有效
words.example: Only a few plants can survive in such dry conditions.

words.zh: v. 提供动力；  n. 力量；能量，能；控制力；权力；电力；功率；幂；电；能力；电力供应；【物】功率；【电】功率；【数】幂次
words.example: Solar panels power the small house with clean energy.

words.zh: n. 水龙头；轻敲；塞子；轻拍；窃听；旋塞，龙头；  v. 轻叩，轻敲；监听，窃听 (电话)；开发，发掘；利用；装水龙头
words.example: Please turn off the tap after washing your hands.

words.zh: n. 管子，导管；烟斗；笛；【计】管道；管道；吹奏的管乐器；  v. 安静下来（pipe down）；用管子输送；用管乐器演奏
words.example: A broken pipe leaked water all over the floor.

words.zh: n. 口哨（声）；汽笛声，警笛声；  v. 吹口哨；呼啸
words.example: The referee blew his whistle to stop the game.

words.zh: n. 紧急情况，突发事件；急诊；【航】紧急情况；  adj. 紧急情况下的；应急的
words.example: Call 120 immediately if there is an emergency.

words.zh: adj. 冷静的，平静的；风平浪静的；无风的；  n. 平静，安宁；镇静；  v. （使）平静，（使）镇定
words.example: She stayed calm even when the fire alarm went off.

words.zh: n. 帮助；救护；辅助设备；救援物资；援助；  v. 援助，帮助
words.example: The injured hiker needed medical aid right away.

words.zh: n. 成套工具；工具箱；装备；  v. 装备
words.example: My dad keeps a repair kit in the garage.

words.zh: phr. 急救包
words.example: Every car should have a first aid kit for emergencies.

words.zh: phr. 手头现有
words.example: We always have some snacks on hand for guests.

words.zh: v. 碰撞；猛撞；坠落；崩溃；暴跌；坠毁；猛撞，碰撞 ；【计】崩溃；  n. 撞车；碰撞；猛撞；坠毁；崩溃；轰隆声；大镲，强音镲；崩盘；  adj. 紧急的
words.example: The two cars crashed at the busy intersection this morning.

words.zh: v. 扫，打扫；席卷，迅速传播；吹过，掠过；吹走，冲走；  n. 清扫；一挥（手，胳膊等）；范围，广度；绵延弯曲的地带
words.example: After the party, we had to sweep the floor and wash all the dishes.

words.zh: phr. 清除掉；扫去
words.example: The violent storm swept away entire houses along the coast.

words.zh: n. 海浪，波浪；挥手；起伏；涌现的人，涌现的事物；卷发，卷曲；波，波状运动；汹涌的行动；  v. 挥手，招手；波动，飘动；挥臂；上下起伏，左右摇晃；摆动，摇动
words.example: A huge wave crashed against the rocks on the beach.

words.zh: v. 击打；袭击；罢工；划（火柴）；突然发生（某种不幸）；突然有坏的影响；顿时使处于某状态；达成，达到；使产生……想法；给（某人以…）印象；让（某人）觉得；弹奏；发出（声音）；撞击；碰撞；敲(钟)，报(时)；  n. 罢工；打击；殴打；袭击；停工，罢工
words.example: The boxer tried to strike his opponent with a powerful punch.

words.zh: v. 递送，交付；分发；发表（演讲）；分娩；投掷；履行；传达；交付，实施；带来
words.example: The mail carrier will deliver the package to your door tomorrow morning.

words.zh: n. 摘要，总结；概括；概要；【计】摘要；  adj. 简略的，概要的
words.example: Please write a short summary of the article we read for homework.

words.zh: v. 使发生；引起；产生；  n. 影响；效果；结果；印象；效应；作用；【计】效果；【化】影响，作用；生效，使某种状态达成
words.example: The new law effected significant improvements in public safety.

words.zh: n. 长度；持续时间；一段 (绳子、布、木头等)；（书或文件的）篇幅，（影片的）时长；【化】长度；【数】长度
words.example: The length of the river is about two hundred kilometers.
